endorsements.name: Todor Donev
endorsements.label: CVE-2019-25226
endorsements.description: Dongyoung Media DM-AP240T/W wireless access points contain an unauthenticated configuration disclosure vulnerability in the /cgi-bin/sys_system_config management endpoint. The endpoint allows remote retrieval of a compressed configuration archive without requiring authentication or authorization. The exposed configuration may include administrative credentials and other sensitive settings, enabling an unauthenticated attacker to obtain information that can facilitate further compromise of the device or network.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 4.0, 8.7)

endorsements.name: Todor Donev
endorsements.label: CVE-2019-25465
endorsements.description: Hisilicon HiIpcam V100R003 contains a directory traversal vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to access sensitive configuration files by exploiting directory listing in the cgi-bin directory. Attackers can request the getadslattr.cgi endpoint to retrieve ADSL credentials and network configuration parameters including usernames, passwords, and DNS settings.

endorsements.name: Todor Donev
endorsements.label: CVE-2019-25472
endorsements.description: IntelBras Telefone IP TIP200 and 200 LITE contain an unauthenticated arbitrary file read vulnerability in the dumpConfigFile function accessible via the cgiServer.exx endpoint. Attackers can send GET requests to /cgi-bin/cgiServer.exx with the command parameter containing dumpConfigFile() to read sensitive files including /etc/shadow and configuration files without proper authorization.

endorsements.name: Todor Donev
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-34048
endorsements.description: A path traversal vulnerability exists in the web management interface of D-Link DSL-2730U, DSL-2750U, and DSL-2750E ADSL routers with firmware versions IN_1.02, SEA_1.04, and SEA_1.07. The vulnerability is due to insufficient input validation on the getpage parameter within the /cgi-bin/webproc CGI script. This flaw allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to perform path traversal attacks by supplying crafted requests, enabling arbitrary file read on the affected device. Exploitation evidence was observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2025-02-04 UTC.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 4.0, 8.7)
